1. The beach. We'll disembark from the boats at the beach. It should be quite safe there, because it's lower than the surrounding terrain, so the enemy will notice us too late to mount an effective defense.
2. The hill. The nearest guard-post is on the hill near the old chapel. This will be our first task - to defeat the guard-post and hold the hill. This is a very strategic position.
3. The Airport. The airport is very heavily defended. We will attack it from the air, but first we must destroy the Shilka that was spotted somewhere to the North.

Inteligence report

Jun 21, 1985 - At last, the invasion of Everon is underway. First of all we have to conquer the airport on the North side of the island - a job for a select few infantry troops. For my infantry troops.

Intel reports that the Reds aren’t expecting us to strike back this quickly. Hell, they’d better not be – or we’re in big trouble out there.

If we can get in quick, though, and wreck their anti-aircraft systems before any armored reinforcement arrive, then our air forces should finish things off easily enough.

At least, that’s what we’re hoping.

Return To Eden
Your first objective is the hill at grid Dj03. Cleanse it of enemy units, and hold it.
Bravo will cover your left flank, and Charlie your right as you put down the expected Soviet counter-attack.
Destroy the defending Shilka and radio the Cobra gunships, designation November, for additional support (0-0-2).
Begin the assault on the airport. When Bravo and Charlie are ready, they will let you know. Send them a signal (0-0-1) to attack.
Secure the Airport.

Congratulations on all your work so far, Lieutenant Armstrong. Now here’s where we start taking this fight back to the Russians. It's time for us to liberate Everon.

To begin with, we need you to secure the airport at the North of the island with an infantry assault.

You will land on the beach at grid reference Eb04.
